title: Push for twice the distance
hook: Change distance and predict work done.
misconception: work done stays fixed when distance doubles.
objective: Apply W = Fd to compare work done when distance changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With a constant force parallel to the displacement, W = Fd. When distance doubles, work done becomes 2 times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model W = Fd; scaling exponent 1. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider a constant force parallel to the displacement, with a nonzero initial result. If distance triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on work done?
recall.why: Apply W = Fd under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 3.
